walkthroughs.title: NexQL: PostgreSQL in VS Code
walkthroughs.description: Connect to a database, explore objects, and run SQL in notebooks.

steps.title: Add a database connection
steps.description:
Save your server and credentials securely, then connect.
[Add PostgreSQL Connection](command:postgres-explorer.addConnection)

steps.title: Open the NexQL explorer
steps.description:
Browse databases, schemas, and objects from the sidebar.
[Show NexQL](command:workbench.view.extension.postgres-explorer)

steps.title: Create a SQL notebook
steps.description:
Use interactive `.pgsql` notebooks for queries and results.
[New SQL Notebook](command:postgres-explorer.newNotebook)

Run the guided wizard to create or unlock your encrypted vault.

[Sync Now](command:postgres-explorer.sync.now)

postgresExplorer.debug.markdownDescription: Write verbose diagnostic logging to the **NexQL Debug** output channel. Off by default to keep SQL, schema, and AI payloads out of logs.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL server

port.description: Port number of the PostgreSQL server

environment.description: Environment tag for safety warnings and visual indicators

readOnlyMode.description: Force read-only transactions for this connection

postgresExplorer.sentinel.enabled.description: Enable Sentinel environment signaling when a tagged .pgsql notebook is focused.

postgresExplorer.sentinel.statusBarAccen.description: Tint status bar connection items by environment (production, staging, development).

postgresExplorer.sentinel.notebookContex.description: Show in-notebook connection context strip with environment chip.

postgresExplorer.sentinel.chromeAccent.description: Tint workbench title bar, activity bar, and status bar chrome by environment.

postgresExplorer.sentinel.tabBadges.description: Show [P]/[S]/[D] badges on open .pgsql notebook tabs for tagged connections.

postgresExplorer.sentinel.chatEnvChip.description: Show environment chip in the NexQL Bot context bar.

postgresExplorer.sentinel.notifyOnTransi.description: Show a notification when the active notebook environment changes (e.g. staging → production).

postgresExplorer.sentinel.themeSwap.enab.description: Advanced: suggest or auto-switch the entire color theme by environment.

postgresExplorer.sentinel.themeSwap.mode.description: How theme swap behaves when themeSwap.enabled is true.

postgresExplorer.sentinel.themeSwap.them.description: Map of environment (production, staging, development) to color theme label.

postgresExplorer.aiApiKey.description: Deprecated: API keys are stored in Secret Storage per provider via AI Settings.

postgresExplorer.ai.chat.provider.description: AI provider for the NexQL Bot chat panel

postgresExplorer.ai.chat.model.description: Model for chat. Leave empty for provider default.

postgresExplorer.ai.notebook.provider.description: AI provider for notebook assist, dashboard, and saved-query AI

postgresExplorer.ai.notebook.model.description: Model for notebook AI features. Leave empty for provider default.

postgresExplorer.opencodeCliPath.description: Optional path to the OpenCode CLI binary. Auto-detected from PATH and common install locations when empty.

postgresExplorer.opencodeWorkingDirector.description: Working directory for OpenCode serve/run. Defaults to the VS Code workspace folder, or ~/.nexql/opencode-wd when the host folder is an IDE install path.

postgresExplorer.opencodeServeUrl.description: OpenCode server URL (opencode serve). Auto-populated when opencodeAutoServe starts a managed server.

postgresExplorer.opencodeAutoServe.description: Automatically start and reuse a local opencode serve instance for faster NexQL Bot requests.

postgresExplorer.opencodeShowLog.description: Show the OpenCode output channel while requests are running (View → Output → OpenCode).

postgresExplorer.opencodeServePort.description: Fixed port for auto-started opencode serve (0 = pick a free port).

postgresExplorer.opencodeSkipPermissions.description: Auto-allow OpenCode tool permissions for headless NexQL Bot runs (YOLO mode). Required when attaching to opencode serve.

postgresExplorer.opencodeAutoApprovePerm.description: Poll the OpenCode server and auto-approve any permission prompts during NexQL Bot requests.

postgresExplorer.opencodePreferSdk.description: When the OpenCode CLI is not found, fall back to @opencode-ai/sdk if installed.

postgresExplorer.ai.maxContextTokens.description: Approximate token budget for AI requests (system prompt + schema context + chat history). Oldest history is dropped first, then schema is trimmed, to keep requests within this budget.

postgresExplorer.telemetry.mode.description: Telemetry collection mode. off disables telemetry. basic sends anonymous usage counters. detailed adds anonymized performance buckets.

postgresExplorer.telemetry.maxBatchSize.description: Maximum number of events per telemetry batch.

postgresExplorer.telemetry.posthogHost.description: PostHog ingestion host used for telemetry transport.

postgresExplorer.telemetry.posthogApiKey.description: PostHog project API key. Keep empty to disable remote telemetry sink.

postgresExplorer.queryTimeout.description: Global query timeout in milliseconds (0 for no timeout). Can be overridden per connection.

postgresExplorer.performance.slowQueryTh.description: Threshold in milliseconds to flag slow queries in history and results.

postgresExplorer.performance.defaultLimi.description: Default row limit for SELECT queries when auto-LIMIT is enabled.

postgresExplorer.performance.slidingWind.description: Use a PostgreSQL SCROLL cursor for eligible SELECT queries (no SQL parameters): stream one window of rows into the cell and fetch more on scroll—bounded RAM on host and webview.
Maximum rows kept in the result grid at once when sliding-window streaming is active.

postgresExplorer.query.autoLimitEnabled.description: Automatically append LIMIT clause to SELECT queries that don't have one. Always enabled in read-only mode.

postgresExplorer.query.byteaDisplayForma.description: Display format for binary (bytea) columns in query results: 0x-prefixed hex, PostgreSQL \x hex, or JSON Buffer shape (debug).

postgresExplorer.query.executionFailureS.description: Strategy when a statement fails in multi-statement execution: 'continue-on-error' (execute remaining, show summary), 'fail-on-error' (stop immediately), 'prompt-on-error' (ask user per failure).

postgresExplorer.parameters.cacheLastVal.description: Remember the last entered SQL parameter values in this workspace.

postgresExplorer.parameters.nullSentinel.description: Exact input text that is sent as SQL NULL for prompted parameters. Set empty string to disable.

postgresExplorer.autoRefresh.enabled.description: Enable automatic background refresh of the explorer tree and notebooks panel.

postgresExplorer.autoRefresh.pollInterva.description: How often (in seconds) to poll PostgreSQL for schema changes.

postgresExplorer.formatter.keywordCase.description: Keyword case used by the SQL formatter.

postgresExplorer.formatter.indentStyle.description: Indent style used by the SQL formatter.

postgresExplorer.formatter.tabWidth.description: Number of spaces per indent level in the SQL formatter.

postgresExplorer.formatter.useTabs.description: Use tabs instead of spaces for SQL formatter indentation.

postgresExplorer.formatter.linesBetweenQ.description: Number of blank lines between SQL statements in the formatter output.

nexql.ddlViewer.openOnSelection.description: Open the Definition Viewer automatically when selecting supported tree items.

nexql.ddlViewer.enabled.description: Enable SQL Preview (Definition Viewer) features and actions.

postgresExplorer.queryHistory.maxItems.description: Maximum number of query history entries to retain. Older entries are removed once the limit is reached.

postgresExplorer.mcp.enabled.markdownDescription: Expose NexQL's read-only database tools as an MCP server by spawning `nexql-mcp` via `npx -y nexql-mcp@latest` (stdio). VS Code Copilot and other MCP clients discover it via the extension registry. On by default.

postgresExplorer.mcp.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a standalone `nexql-mcp` binary. Used as a fallback when Node.js/npx is not available. When empty, NexQL tries `NEXQL_MCP_BIN`, then PATH.

postgresExplorer.mcp.maxRows.markdownDescription: Maximum number of rows returned by AI tool queries (`run_select`). Results beyond this limit are truncated and flagged. Applies to both NexQL Bot and MCP clients.

postgresExplorer.mcp.toolProfile.markdownDescription: Tool surface exposed to the NexQL Bot MCP client. `full` (default) sends all tools; `meta` sends a small core set plus `discover_tools`; `query`/`dba` are intent-scoped subsets.

postgresExplorer.ai.agenticMaxSteps.markdownDescription: Maximum agentic tool-loop steps per NexQL Bot run. Oldest history is trimmed first when context is tight.

postgresExplorer.aiProvider.description: Deprecated: use ai.notebook.provider or ai.chat.provider. Kept for migration.

enumDescriptions: No metering — all features unlimited for everyone (development / dark-ship).
Freemium: free tier gets daily/weekly per-feature allowances; paid tiers are unlimited (default).
postgresExplorer.license.enforcement.markdownDescription: Controls premium feature access. `freemium` (default) gives the free tier metered daily/weekly use of premium features and unlimited use to paid subscribers. `off` disables all metering. Legacy values `soft`/`hard` are treated as `freemium`.

postgresExplorer.license.endpoint.description: Base URL for the NexQL license validation API.

postgresExplorer.sync.auto.description: Enable automatic sync (pull on activation, debounced push, periodic pull).

postgresExplorer.sync.notebookFolder.description: Folder for synced .pgsql notebooks (supports ~ for home directory).

postgresExplorer.sync.pullIntervalMinute.description: Interval in minutes for periodic sync pulls.

postgresExplorer.sync.apiEndpoint.description: Base URL for NexQL account and cloud sync API.

postgresExplorer.sync.postgresConnection.description: Connection ID for optional team Postgres sync backend (nexql_sync schema).

postgresExplorer.dbIndex.enableEmbedding.description: Enable vector embeddings generation for tables and views to support semantic search grounding in AI tools.

postgresExplorer.dbIndex.autoBuild.description: Automatically build and keep the local database index up to date (structure only) in the background for connected databases. Requires Auto Database Indexing (Sponsor).

postgresExplorer.query.defaultExperience.description: Default SQL workspace when opening Query Tool (notebook or Query Studio).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run esbuild-base:free -- --minify && npm run esbuild-renderer:free -- --minify && npm run esbuild-erd-webview:free -- --minify && npm run esbuild-chat-chart -- --minify
scripts.vscode:prepublish:pro: npm run esbuild-base:pro -- --minify && npm run esbuild-renderer:pro -- --minify && npm run esbuild-erd-webview:pro -- --minify && npm run esbuild-query-studio:pro -- --minify && npm run esbuild-chat-chart -- --minify
scripts.compile: tsc -p ./ && npm run esbuild-renderer:free && npm run esbuild-erd-webview && npm run esbuild-chat-chart && npm run copy-templates
scripts.compile:pro: npm run typecheck:pro && npm run esbuild:pro && npm run copy-templates
scripts.typecheck:pro: if [ -d packages/pro ]; then tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.pro.typecheck.json; else echo 'packages/pro absent — skipping pro typecheck'; fi
scripts.esbuild:free: npm run esbuild-base:free -- --sourcemap && npm run esbuild-renderer:free -- --sourcemap && npm run esbuild-erd-webview:free -- --sourcemap && npm run esbuild-chat-chart -- --sourcemap
scripts.esbuild:pro: npm run esbuild-base:pro -- --sourcemap && npm run esbuild-renderer:pro -- --sourcemap && npm run esbuild-erd-webview:pro -- --sourcemap && npm run esbuild-query-studio:pro -- --sourcemap && npm run esbuild-chat-chart -- --sourcemap
scripts.esbuild-watch: npm run esbuild-base:free -- --sourcemap --watch & npm run esbuild-renderer:free -- --sourcemap --watch & npm run esbuild-erd-webview:free -- --sourcemap --watch & npm run esbuild-chat-chart -- --sourcemap --watch
scripts.test: npm run compile && node --no-experimental-strip-types ./node_modules/mocha/bin/mocha --loader ./node_modules/ts-node/esm/transpile-only.mjs -r tsconfig-paths/register -r src/test/setup.ts 'src/test/unit/**/*.test.ts'
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile && TS_NODE_PROJECT=src/test/tsconfig.json node --no-experimental-strip-types -r ts-node/register/transpile-only -r tsconfig-paths/register -r ./src/test/setup.ts ./node_modules/mocha/bin/mocha --exit 'src/test/unit/**/*.test.ts'
scripts.test:unit:pro: if [ -d packages/pro/test ]; then TS_NODE_PROJECT=src/test/tsconfig.json node --preserve-symlinks --preserve-symlinks-main --no-experimental-strip-types -r ts-node/register/transpile-only -r tsconfig-paths/register -r ./src/test/setup.ts ./node_modules/mocha/bin/mocha --exit 'packages/pro/test/**/*.test.ts'; else echo 'packages/pro absent — skipping pro tests'; fi
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && ts-mocha -p src/test/tsconfig.json -r tsconfig-paths/register -r src/test/setup.ts 'src/test/integration/**/*.test.ts'
scripts.test:renderer: npm run compile && ts-mocha -p src/test/tsconfig.json -r tsconfig-paths/register -r src/test/setup.ts 'src/test/unit/RendererComponents.test.ts'
scripts.test:renderer:coverage: npm run compile && nyc ts-mocha -p src/test/tsconfig.json -r tsconfig-paths/register -r src/test/setup.ts 'src/test/unit/RendererComponents.test.ts'
scripts.test:versions: npm run compile && ts-mocha -p src/test/tsconfig.json -r tsconfig-paths/register -r src/test/setup.ts 'src/test/integration/ConnectionLifecycle.test.ts'
scripts.test:all: npm run compile && ts-mocha -p src/test/tsconfig.json -r ts-node/register -r tsconfig-paths/register -r src/test/setup.ts 'src/test/**/*.test.ts'
scripts.coverage: npm run compile && nyc ts-mocha -p src/test/tsconfig.json -r tsconfig-paths/register -r src/test/setup.ts --exit 'src/test/unit/**/*.test.ts'
scripts.coverage:phase-utils: npm run compile && npx c8 --config .c8rc.phase-utils.json ts-mocha -p src/test/tsconfig.json -r tsconfig-paths/register -r src/test/setup.ts 'src/test/unit/pgPassUtils.test.ts' 'src/test/unit/connectionUtils.test.ts' 'src/test/unit/NotebookTitle.test.ts'
scripts.coverage:phase-handlers: npm run compile && npx c8 --config .c8rc.phase-handlers.json ts-mocha -p src/test/tsconfig.json -r tsconfig-paths/register -r src/test/setup.ts 'src/test/unit/CoreHandlers.test.ts' 'src/test/unit/ExplainHandlers.test.ts' 'src/test/unit/TransactionHandlers.test.ts' 'src/test/unit/QueryHandlers.test.ts' 'src/test/unit/QueryHandlers.extended.test.ts'
scripts.coverage:phased: npm run coverage:phase-utils && npm run coverage:phase-handlers && node ./scripts/merge-coverage.js && npm run coverage:report
